expr: const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-file-card]')].find(c => c.querySelector('.filecard__name').textContent.includes('音调')); const chips=[...card.querySelectorAll('.chip')].map(c=>c.textContent.trim()); [...card.querySelectorAll('.chip')].find(c => c.textContent.includes('MP3'))?.click(); return chips;

const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-file-card]')].find(c => c.querySelector('.filecard__name').textContent.includes('样张')); const chips=[...card.querySelectorAll('.chip')].map(c=>c.textContent.trim()); [...card.querySelectorAll('.chip')].find(c => c.textContent.includes('PNG'))?.click(); return chips;

const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-file-card]')].find(c => c.querySelector('.filecard__name').textContent.includes('小说片段')); const chips=[...card.querySelectorAll('.chip')].map(c=>c.textContent.trim()); const active = card.querySelector('.chip--active')?.textContent?.trim(); return { chips, active, encoding: [...card.querySelectorAll('.badge')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()) };

return { done: document.querySelectorAll('[data-state=done]').length, error: document.querySelectorAll('[data-state=error]').length, results: [...document.querySelectorAll('.result')].map(r => ({ name: r.querySelector('.result__name')?.textContent, badges: [...r.querySelectorAll('.badge')].map(b => b.textContent.trim()) })), errors: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-status=fail] .case__detail')].map(e => e.textContent.slice(0, 180)) };
